working_palette_note: Working proposal, NOT a statement of manufacturing availability or user-approved colors; the 4-color standard is derived from documented color names across existing sources.

store_html_discrepancy.impact_if_approved: 12 designs × 4 = 48 total colorway slots; 33 new slots relative to the 15 source-documented core catalog SKUs, before any H012 assets are verified.
